description: Quality verification harness for community_signal_enrichment.py. Loads the enricher module, calls compute_score() against a synthetic corpus of 20+ metadata dicts with varied stars, registry_source, download_count, dependency_count fields. Asserts that output scores produce at least 15 distinct values (signal quality floor). The signal diagnostic shows community_signal at 34 distinct values which is OK, but this harness verifies the enricher specifically. Logs score distribution. Does NOT modify the enricher. Diagnostic tool. References spec section 3 signal invariant.
